details: Following the June FOMC meeting, the Federal Reserve's updated "dot plot" indicates a more hawkish outlook under new Chair Kevin Warsh, with a higher median year-end interest rate projection. Markets are now reflecting a 36% probability of a July rate hike and over 70% for September, a significant increase from a week prior. This aggressive stance, aimed at combating persistent inflation, is making higher-yielding traditional assets more attractive and leading to continued outflows from risk assets like Bitcoin ETFs, contributing to a downward pressure on cryptocurrency prices.
title: Fed's Hawkish Stance Fuels Rate Hike Bets, Pressures Crypto

details: The U.S. House of Representatives has passed a bill that prohibits the Federal Reserve from developing and issuing a central bank digital currency (CBDC) until at least 2030, without explicit Congressional approval. This legislative move is seen as supportive of private stablecoins and decentralized finance (DeFi) liquidity within the U.S., as it temporarily removes a potential government-backed competitor in the digital currency landscape.
title: US House Passes Bill Halting Fed CBDC Until 2030

details: Ongoing geopolitical tensions, particularly in the Middle East, remain a significant factor impacting global financial markets and cryptocurrencies. Such events historically trigger a "risk-off" sentiment, leading investors to reduce exposure to volatile assets like Bitcoin. Concerns persist regarding the Strait of Hormuz, a critical energy route; any disruptions could cause oil prices to spike, exacerbating inflation fears and potentially prompting further central bank rate hikes, which would negatively affect crypto market liquidity and investor sentiment.
title: Geopolitical Tensions in Middle East Continue to Influence Crypto Markets
